newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES FALL IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES FALL IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: Activity slowed on the Lusaka
stock exchange in the week ended July 4, exchange officials
said.
They said volume dropped to 797,193 shares valued at
68,274,120 kwacha from 6,349,729 shares valued at 748,332,473
kwacha in the previous week.
Chilanga Cement dropped 10 kwacha to end the week at 120
kwacha in a traded volume of 55,544 shares valued at 6,259,292
kwacha.
Rothmans gained five kwacha to close at 55 kwacha and saw
245 shares valued at 263,475 kwacha change hands.
Zambia Sugar gained five kwacha to close at 40 kwacha and
saw 276,767 shares valued at 9,611,054 kwacha exchanging hands.
Zambian Breweries closed at 210 kwacha, down 65 kwacha, in a
traded volume of 186,689 shares valued at 48,526,975 kwacha.
"The drop in Zambian Breweries appears to have been
occasioned by liquidity demands but would appear to be a welcome
cooling off on the price which had risen 83 percent within one
month of its listing," an exchange official said.
Farmers House, Trans Zambezi Industries and Zambia
Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) were untraded during the week.
